verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state "Everything in Omarchy happens via the keyboard — EVERYTHING!" and detail keyboard-triggered launcher/clipboard/dictation features (Super+Ctrl+V, F9/Super+Ctrl+X), consistent with Hyprland-based keyboard-driven window management praised by community reviewers. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of full keyboard-only operation (no mouse) and a comprehensive hotkey reference beyond the few examples cited.
